Oman Net Salary Calculator

Enter your gross wage with all allowances to see each deduction, your net pay and the employer's share.

Examples:
Omani on 1,400: 105 + 7 = 112 is deducted and net pay is OMR 1,288; the employer pays 203.
Omani on 14,000: the pension applies to 3,000 only (225) and job security to the full wage (70), so 295 is deducted and net pay is 13,705.
Expat on 1,400: nothing is deducted; the employer pays 28.

Insurable pay is the gross wage with all allowances, and pension contributions are calculated daily. The Ministry of Finance may subsidise the insured person's share, but we found no decision in force. GCC nationals working in Oman contribute at their home country's rates through the insurance protection extension scheme.

For your pension use the Oman pension calculator, and for job security the job security allowance calculator.

Frequently asked questions

How much is deducted from an Omani's salary for social protection?

8%: 7.5% for the old-age, disability and death branch on pay up to OMR 3,000, and 0.5% for job security on the full wage, under Social Protection Law 52/2023 in force since 1 January 2024.

What is the employer's share in Oman in 2026?

14.5% for Omanis since 19 July 2026: 11% pension and 1% work injury (up to 3,000), plus 1% maternity, 1% sick leave and 0.5% job security on the full wage. It was 13.5% before the sick leave branch started.

Is anything deducted from an expat's salary in Oman?

Nothing is deducted from expats. The employer pays 1% for maternity insurance since July 2024 and 1% for sick leave since July 2026; a savings scheme of 9% of basic starts by 19 July 2027 at the latest, and 1% work injury by 19 July 2028.
